name: cable half kneeling push pull
description: From a half kneeling stance you press one handle forward and pull another back at the same time. It challenges core stability and coordination.
instructions: Kneel on one knee between two cable stations, holding a handle in each hand.
Keep your torso tall and your core braced.
Press one handle forward while pulling the other toward your ribs.
Return to the start under control.
Do not let your torso twist.
Switch your kneeling leg after a set.
